newsitem.title: USA: United Auto's Cogan adds president title.
newsitem.headline: United Auto's Cogan adds president title.

text.p: United Auto Group Inc said on Wednesday that its chairman/chief executive, Marshall Cogan, will add the title of president.
That action terminated the search United Auto had been conducting to fill the office of president, the company said in a news release. No one previously served in that position.
The chief financial officer, Robert Nelson, becomes executive vice president for operations, a new position.
Karl Winters will be promoted from treasurer to chief financial officer.
United Auto is an auto retailer.
